Contributing to Plumb
=====================

Plumb takes spam-policy filters as pull requests, and fixes to the filters it
already ships. What a filter needs and how it gets reviewed are in the
[README](../README.md#submitting-a-filter); the merge and release steps are in
[plumb/MAINTAINING.md](../plumb/MAINTAINING.md).

Everything else in the tree is Bitcoin Knots. Changes there go upstream to
https://github.com/bitcoinknots/bitcoin, or to Bitcoin Core first; see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
